title: Crawler roster (011: the front door)
comment: public/data/crawlers.json. Authored, never generated: the live numbers (level, HP, floor) come from the build-time status.json. Amended by 012: the 'status' field is gone - a crawler's condition is authored per episode in content/status/<id>.json and reaches a reader only inside a card they have chosen to reveal, never as a property of the roster. Amended by 014: the player moved to cast.json (specs/014-cast-page/contracts/cast.schema.json); a crawler no longer describes the person who plays them.

todo.comment: What the author still has to fill in. Rendered nowhere; read by humans and by the README.

id.comment: The hub crawler id, so status.json joins without a mapping table.

concept.comment: Empty is a real state: the page renders nothing rather than a placeholder (011 R2).

reward.comment: The verbatim reward paragraph, under the "Reward: {box} -> {item}" payout line.

lineup.comment: The full figure trimmed to its bounds, for the home hero's group shot.
